name: ckam-release-201ef76
purpose: CKAM release: The ERP copy keeps every supplier that has ever been on a Fixed Assets PO (Add from ERP lists them, e.g. DEV IT SERV), not only suppliers of recent POs
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
built_from: git archive of the committed tree 201ef76 (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=201ef76 npm run build; npm run check:build
database_change: NONE. No migration in this release: production stays at e8a0c2d4f6b8 and alembic upgrade head is a no-op.

migration_notes.rollback: No schema change, so the previous release 89d377b can be started again from its release folder (same schema). Never start 3b5e842 or older.
migration_notes.never: Never start release 3b5e842 or older: it has the IF-01 file-read hole.

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip: see MANIFEST.201ef76.sha256.txt next to the zip
